subject: infra.energy
name: Power provision for data-centre and telecom infrastructure
what_would_settle_it: a Senegalese primary carrying the installed capacity of the data-centre estate, a utility tariff or supply agreement for a named facility, or a government decision on the industry recommendation

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team
what_would_settle_it: a decree or ministerial order creating a national response team or cybersecurity agency, or an official statement naming one that already exists

subject: data.open
name: Open government data policy, portal or licence
what_would_settle_it: a decree or circular on public-data re-use, a national open-data portal ingested as a primary, or a published open-data charter

subject: dpi.id
name: Universal digital identity under the technology strategy
what_would_settle_it: a build contract, pilot record or enrolment figure for the universal digital identity the strategy announced

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital data capture
what_would_settle_it: a source on tablet-based rural enumeration, agricultural census digitisation or field-level data collection

subject: data.satellite
name: Use of satellite data in public administration
what_would_settle_it: a statistics-agency, agriculture-ministry or land-administration document showing earth-observation data feeding an official statistic, cadastre or crop estimate

subject: digital.localgov
name: Commune-level systems other than civil status
what_would_settle_it: a source on a commune-level administrative system that is not the civil register

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Place in an AI readiness index
what_would_settle_it: Senegal's inclusion in a future edition, or any other AI-readiness index publishing a Senegal score

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Senegal-India technology cooperation
what_would_settle_it: any dated Indian-government, export-bank or Indian-vendor announcement naming Senegal

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Senegal-Gulf technology investment
what_would_settle_it: a dated investment agreement, memorandum or facility naming a Gulf counterparty

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital-sector budget outturn, execution and audit
what_would_settle_it: the quarterly budget-execution report with ministry or programme disaggregation, or the audit court's settlement law for FY2024 or FY2025

subject: include.divides
name: Domestic measurement of the digital divide or digital literacy
what_would_settle_it: a statistics-agency or regulator household ICT-usage survey, or a ministry digital-skills baseline
